name: TuneLoft
summary:
TuneLoft turns your headset into a universal media hub. One player for everything you already own — no walled garden, no content of ours to buy.

MANY SOURCES, YOUR WAY
• Plex — browse and play your Plex libraries in full quality.
• DLNA / UPnP — stream from your NAS, PC or home media server.
• Local files — play what's on your device or local network.
• Live streams — point TuneLoft at your own M3U / Xtream sources and it plays them too, with EPG.
